title: Incident triage team
description: Three agents that work a problem together: one reads the failed runs, one checks the platform and the cloud, and a lead writes one short report with the next steps.

skills.name: Triage failed runs
skills.description: Steps for finding why runs fail.
skills.body:
1. List recent failed runs with list_runs (status failed).
2. For the newest three, read run_failure and say which step failed first and why.
3. Read the end of that step's log with get_step_log only when run_failure is not enough.
4. Group failures that share a cause.
5. For each cause, name the run ids that showed it and the most likely fix. Say clearly when you are guessing.

skills.name: Check the platform
skills.description: Steps for checking what runs underneath.
skills.body:
1. Run morning_check and note anything that needs a person.
2. Read the AWS resources with aws_resources and look for things that are failing or changing.
3. If Kubernetes clusters are registered, list them with k8s_clusters and read the busiest with k8s_resources.
4. Report only what you saw, with the lookup that showed it.

agents.name: Run analyst
agents.instructions: You read failed runs and explain why they failed. Use the triage skill. Name the run id behind every claim.

agents.name: Platform checker
agents.description: Checks the Docker host, the cloud and clusters.
agents.instructions: You check the platform under the pipelines. Use the platform skill. Say what you could not check.

agents.name: Triage lead
agents.description: Turns the team's findings into one short report.
agents.instructions: You lead an incident triage. You get what the run analyst and the platform checker found. Write one short report: what is broken, the most likely cause, and the next two steps in order. Keep every claim tied to what a teammate found; never add facts of your own.

workflows.name: Triage what is failing
workflows.description: Runs and platform checked together, then one report.

steps.task: Find why the recent failed runs failed.
Check the platform and the cloud for anything failing or changing.
Write the triage report from what the team found.
